subject: Mutual Action Plan: Finexa pricing & commit runway
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@finexa.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finexa Procurement <procurement@finexa.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kick-off: pricing questions and timeline

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and platform controls. Attached is an updated mutual action plan (MAP_Finexa_v3.pdf) with our evaluation milestones and a draft procurement timeline. A couple items we need to lock down from your side so procurement can move forward: 

- A clear committed spend profile (monthly or annual) you can price to.
- What level of discount is available for a 12-month vs 24-month commitment (and any credit offers).
- Any required paperwork or SOC evidence procurement will request and expected lead times.

Procurement is asking for a target decision by Mon May 10 so they can plan their budgeting and legal review. Can you confirm who on your side will own commit sizing and an internal approval path?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Finexa

Attachments: MAP_Finexa_v3.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@finexa.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kick-off: pricing questions and timeline

Emma — thanks for the MAP and the timeline. I reviewed with the team and attaching two files so Finexa procurement has concrete options: Pricing_Scenarios.xlsx (3 commit tiers) and an internal redlineable MAP.

Quick summary:
- Commit tiers: $200k/yr (base), $400k/yr (preferred), $800k/yr (enterprise).
- Discount guidance (prelim): 10% @ $200k, 15% @ $400k, 20% @ $800k.
- One-time credits (negotiable): $10k @ base, $50k @ preferred, $120k @ enterprise — credits to be applied to first billing period.

Neha (CC) will own approvals for discounts and credits; Dev will own billing/contract sizing and procurement onboarding.

Next steps I propose: weekly MAP checkpoint (15 min) until decision. Today I can escalate the preferred $400k scenario internally for fast approval if Finexa is ready to confirm by Mon 5/10.

Pls see attached and let me know preferred commit tier.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0123

Attachments: Pricing_Scenarios.xlsx, MAP_Finexa_v3.pdf
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan kick-off: pricing questions and timeline

Rishi — I looked at the Pricing_Scenarios.xlsx and ran it past finance. A few notes from the approvals side: 

- We can provisionally approve up to 15% discount (for $400k/yr) with a standard non-refundable credit structure, but we need a justification note from you about strategic rationale (expansion potential, reference customer value).
- Credits need PO cover or a short memo from customer procurement; finance needs the PO reference before issuing credits.
- Legal will want to see the redlined MAP and preferred term (12 vs 24 months) — ask Finexa to flag the term they prefer.

If Finexa confirms $400k/yr + 12 months and can get procurement PO by 5/12, we can lock the 15% + $50k credit offer and start the DocuSign flow. Otherwise we'll default to 10% for $200k.

I can approve the 15% conditional on PO and a one-page strategic note — Rishi, can you draft that (2–3 bullets) and I will sign off? Dev, can you confirm billing setup and the lead time for applying credits once PO is in?

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@finexa.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finexa Procurement <procurement@finexa.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kick-off: pricing questions and timeline

Rishi — we've discussed internally. Procurement prefers the 12-month term with the $400k/yr commit. Procurement timeline: PO by Wed 5/12, legal review 3 business days, and hope to sign by 5/17. They asked for a one-page justification to speed finance sign-off (we can include it in the PO package).

We can provisionally proceed with the MAP v3 redlines — procurement will attach final redlines after legal review. Please confirm the 15% + $50k credit proposal in writing so I can include it in the PO notes.

Emma
Emma Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Finexa

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma.chen@finexa.com>
Date: Mon, 9 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint — approvals and action items (Finexa)

Team — quick checkpoint after Finexa confirmed preferred tier. Consolidating decisions and owners so we have a single source of truth: 

Decisions (agreed internally):
- Offer: 15% discount on list rates for a 12-month commit at $400k/yr.
- One-time credit: $50,000 applied to first invoice; credit issuance contingent on receiving customer PO reference.
- MAP redline: waiting on Finexa legal; we will accept standard redlines but flag any SLA or data residency clauses for leadership.

Action items and owners:
- Rishi: Draft 1-page strategic justification for the 15% offer (due Tue 5/11 EOD). [ACTION: rishi_malhotra]
- Neha: Conditional sign-off on 15% upon receipt of PO and justification (will sign within 24 hours after PO). [ACTION: neha_kapoor]
- Dev: Confirm billing tokenization and timeline to apply the $50k credit once PO arrives (due Tue 5/11). cc: procurement onboarding steps. [ACTION: dev_patel]
- Marissa: Prep DocuSign envelope and standard T&Cs for 12-month term, plus route to legal if there are material redlines (due Wed 5/12). [ACTION: marissa_cole]

External communication: I replied to Emma confirming the 15% + $50k credit and asked for PO target of 5/12. Dropped a DocuSign draft link to speed signature (see related_links).

I'll attach the updated MAP with our notes once DocuSign is live. If anyone sees risk with the 15% approval path, flag now.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_Finexa_v4.pdf
